## Overall objective

Provide a deterministic 4-US fixture exercising the synthesis stage of
`/yoke:generate-sprints`. The synthesis MUST produce ≥4 tasks where
every US (US-001..US-004) appears in at least one task's
`realizes_user_stories` array. The fixture's USs are intentionally
shaped so an LLM (or a deterministic stub) can realize them
1-task-per-US without ambiguity.

## Contracts and interfaces

- Input parser contract — AC parser emits `user_stories` shape per the
  binding spec contracts.
- Synthesis output contract — task list with `task_id`,
  `realizes_user_stories`, `applies_decisions`, `instructions`,
  `sensors`, `acceptance_criterion`.
- US-trace clause — every Story line ends with
  `(Realizes: US-NNN[, US-MMM])`.

## Dependencies

### External services and libraries

- python3 (already a Yoke hard dependency).
- yq (already a Yoke hard dependency).

### Internal prior work

- `lib/working-memory/paths.sh` — slug resolution and path helpers.

### Cross-team coordination

- None — fixture is self-contained.

## Out of scope

- Partition + render exercising — covered by sibling fixtures.
- Trigger 2.5 — covered by sibling fixtures.
